messages:
tan: alert - ap-southeast1 cohort `nvme-therm-09` causing GPU attach backlog (approx 34 pending). noticed a bunch of thermal warnings and very long iops tails.
rachel: confirm. iostat shows nvme0 %util pegged and avgqu-sz small. temps reported at 78-85C with repeated thermal throttling messages.
omar: dmesg snippet on host gnode-apse1-092:
```
[ 4521.001] nvme nvme0: temperature above threshold (82C), throttling
[ 4521.002] nvme nvme0: Admin command timeout
[ 4521.500] blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme0n1, sector 102400
```
lucy: these drives were in fw v7.2.0 batch rolled last week. we also had background scrub + nightly temperature hysteresis job kicking in at 00:20 local.
tan: timeline looks like scrub + ambient rack temp spike + heavy autoscaler batch at 00:22 = compounding effect causing write amp and thermal throttle.
ops-bot: ALERT GPU_PROVISIONING_HOLD ap-southeast1: 34 pending at 1755552400
rachel: mitigation suggestions: 1) pause scrub/trim on cohort; 2) reduce scrub concurrency; 3) cordon noisy nodes and exclude pool from autoscaler; 4) throttle GPU-provisioner for that region for 20m.
omar: toggled maintenance flag: `storage.scrub.concurrent=1` for label cohort=nvme-therm-09. applying taint `nvme-hot:NoSchedule` to 8 affected nodes.
lucy: cordon+drain started on noisy hosts. moving only pending GPU attaches to healthy pools to minimize cross-region spill.
tan: ops - if we spill >25% to us-west will incur egress and spot delta. recommend minimal spill: only failing attaches move.
oncall: incident INC-2026-2456 opened, tagging storage/hardware and facilities for rack cooling check.
ops-bot: autoscaler deploy started with `--exclude-pool=apse1-nvme-therm-09` at 1755552900
rachel: after cordons attach success rose to ~80%. a couple drives show persistent SMART increases; scheduling RMA for 2 drives.
omar: follow-ups: 1) add Grafana panel correlating nvme temp, thermal-throttle events, %util, and gpu-provisioner pending; 2) add alert for nvme thermal throttle >2 in 10m; 3) require firmware rollout plan to coordinate scrub windows and rack cooling maintenance.
lucy: short-term plan: replace 2 drives, keep rest under monitored flag; re-enable scrub in 90m with concurrency=1 and temperature-aware gating.
tan: cost decision: accepted short spill for SLA protection. schedule postmortem tomorrow to update runbook and firmware rollout checklist. :coffee:
ops-bot: scheduled follow-up runbook task created (TASK-2026-77) and cooling ops pinged at 1755553000
